name: exam-ready-inbox
goal: Thông báo chuông cho host khi bản đề sẵn sàng xem thử.
design_constraints: Use the existing transactional inbox pipeline and SESSION target routing; do not create a second notification transport or app-specific bell.
Emit only on the first successful DRAFT to READY generation, with the generating HOST_ADMIN as the sole tenant-scoped recipient; READY replay must not emit.
The notification event and inbox append must run BEFORE_COMMIT and remain rollback-atomic; the Flyway migration must preserve every existing notification type.
Keep notification copy stable and free of tokens, signed URLs, or volatile timestamps; preserve existing tenant/vendor notification behavior.

repository_conventions: Spring modules expose public domain events and use constructor injection; inbox listeners use BEFORE_COMMIT with InboxAppendService.
Flyway migrations are append-only under app/src/main/resources/db/migration and existing notification contracts are covered by JUnit plus optional Postgres integration suites.
The web notification bell and history consume the shared api-client union and existing SESSION target route.
boundaries: Only the exact API, web type, focused test, migration and plan-report paths in quang-execution-file-manifest.md may change.
Do not modify the baseline migration, email notification taxonomy, shared transport, or unrelated dirty worktree files.
applicable_rules: Validate actor membership and tenant scope before creating the sole recipient; never broadcast to students or all hosts for this event.
Use a deterministic event key and frozen event payload so retries are idempotent and cannot conflict from changing audience data.
Record missing dedicated Postgres test infrastructure as SKIPPED rather than treating a unit-only test as database proof.
allowed_exceptions: Quality gate is skipped by Quang and must remain skipped_by_user; unit/integration tests are required and owned by ck:test.

steps.description: Tạo session-owned ExamPreviewReadyEvent với session/tenant/snapshot/name/code/actor/time; emit chỉ DRAFT->READY thành công trong generate transaction, không emit READY replay.
success_criteria: Generate tests chứng minh event emit 1 lần DRAFT->READY, zero lần khi READY replay.

steps.description: Add SESSION_PREVIEW_READY enum và validMapping SESSION/SESSION; constants dùng common message convention; actor active HOST_ADMIN đúng tenant là recipient, không creator field/broadcast.
success_criteria: New enum mapping validated SESSION/SESSION; recipient actor membership verified, zero student recipients.

steps.description: Tạo listener BEFORE_COMMIT -> MANDATORY append, stable key session:snapshot:actor, frozen audience/payload. Rollback không còn inbox; retry không conflict do nội dung volatile. Handoff §6.
success_criteria: Postgres transaction tests NO01–06/NO09 chứng minh single dedup item/rollback atomic, payload ổn định.

steps.description: Bắt buộc thêm Flyway migration NEXT version sửa notifications_notification_type_check đủ old+new allowlist. Ghi tên chính xác vào file manifest/phase trước write. Không sửa V1 và không tạo preview tables.
success_criteria: Actual fresh+upgrade Flyway test chấp nhận SESSION_PREVIEW_READY, preserves old notification values/rows.

steps.description: Add API-client union + rà all exhaustive consumer maps; reuse SESSION target link và common bell/history/read/unread, transport hiện có; locale copy theo thực tế server rendering, không thêm i18n keys không dùng.
success_criteria: Web typecheck/scoped bell-history tests pass; SESSION link/read/unread behavior unchanged; không transport thứ hai.

steps.description: Test event replay/concurrency/rollback/actor và actual Flyway upgrade trên Postgres; bell integration/read count. NO01–09, báo SKIPPED khi thiếu test DB thay vì pass giả.
success_criteria: NO01–09 evidence có actual Postgres results; absent DB là SKIPPED chứ không test success.
